behaviors.behavior: is_generated_path hides the closed 3-name reply family (spec/code/doubt_review_reply.json), anchored to exactly one run-directory segment
is_generated_path hides external-*review*.json/.md siblings under the same run-directory anchoring, including .md raw transcripts
self-review-payload.json is excluded from BOTH is_generated_path and is_safe_to_skip_review (payload sent TO a review, not a transcript OF one)
is_safe_to_skip_review matches ONLY reviews.json, anchored to one run-directory segment, case-sensitively
the reply family and external family are hidden from the model but never skip-safe -- a PR touching only one still gets a real review call
an attacker-chosen filename (evil_reply.json, external-my-own-review-of-this.json) is never skip-safe, and a reply-shaped attacker name is not even hidden
lookalike/boundary paths (.bak suffix, bare-top-level, over-nested for both reply and external families) are rejected by the anchored regexes
pre-existing legacy review-evidence shape, agent-doc exclusions, and canonical-basename anchoring are unchanged -- no regression
behaviors.evidence: plugins/shipwright-security/tests/ full suite 1028 passed, 7 skipped (all pre-existing test_pr_review_filter.py / test_pr_review_generated_skip_review.py assertions unchanged)

surface_verification.justification: Pure library-logic change (path classifier regexes) verified by the plugin's own unit test suite, 1028 passed; not a running app surface -- no UI/API/CLI entry point of its own, consumed only by a GitHub Actions workflow step.
